Q434.reason: Under UCC 2-209, the bakery's shipment in reliance on the oral modification makes it binding despite the no-oral-modification clause.

Q441.reason: A guilty plea to DUI in a criminal case is hearsay in a later civil suit against a different party and is inadmissible.
